svg.title: Layer signals at the safe waiting place
svg.desc: A working three-panel card grouping five non-fire signalling modes at the safe waiting place. The modes are parallel, not steps: emergency contact or alert, continuous bright contrast, sound, a purpose-made daylight mirror in sunlight and a controlled night light. Each mode may be absent. The card says human life comes first in a true immediate emergency but that this card supplies no fire, flare, pyrotechnic or laser method. It says not to leave urgent care, shelter, warmth or the reported place merely to signal and that a possible reply does not confirm contact. It gives no detection range, exact timing, reply code, ground-air construction, product performance, device method or rescue guarantee. The 90 and 60 percent figures estimate source-match and completeness, not outcomes.
svg.text: LAYER SIGNALS — SAFE WAITING PLACE
WORKING CARD · PANEL A OF 3 · USE ALL PANELS
WARNING — SIGNALS DO NOT PROVE CONTACT OR RESCUE
These five modes are a project grouping, not an official rescue sequence.
Use more than one safe mode when possible at the safe waiting place.
True immediate threat to human life: use Chapter 1's life-first test.
No fire, flare, pyrotechnic or laser method is unlocked by this card.
EVIDENCE + EDITORIAL CONFIDENCE
High for the separate basic principles; Moderate for this untested combined set.
Estimates: 90% source-match; 60% combined completeness and layout.
These subjective estimates are not probabilities of detection, contact, rescue,
safety, product performance or survival.
PARALLEL MODES — NOT FIVE STEPS
You do not need all five. Do not delay or move to add a missing mode.
EMERGENCY CONTACT
OR ALERT
BRIGHT CONTRAST
THAT STAYS OUT
SOUND
PURPOSE-MADE MIRROR
IN SUNLIGHT
CONTROLLED NIGHT LIGHT
KEEP POWER FOR CONTACT + CARE
WORKING DRAFT · ALSO READ B–C · NEVER USE THIS DETACHED PANEL ALONE
CONTACT / ALERT + BRIGHT CONTRAST
WORKING CARD · PANEL B OF 3 · PANEL A CONTROLS
PARALLEL MODES — NOT THE NEXT STEPS
Keep urgent care, shelter, warmth and the safe waiting place.
Whole card: 90% source-match; 60% completeness/layout — not outcome odds.
WITH A PHONE, SATELLITE SOS OR DISTRESS BEACON
Use Chapter 3 and the exact device instructions. Report the position and its
uncertainty with IM-184. A screen position does not prove an alert was sent.
If a distress beacon is activated for this real emergency, leave it on until rescue
services advise otherwise. Keep other devices reachable and preserve power.
WITHOUT A WORKING CONTACT OR ALERT ROUTE
Mark it ABSENT or UNCONFIRMED. Do not invent coordinates, functions or status.
Do not climb or wander for reception. Keep the other safe modes.
WITH SAFE SPARE BRIGHT MATERIAL
Use a bright item that contrasts with the background. Secure it at or immediately
beside the safe waiting place. Tell responders if the signal and your position differ.
WITHOUT SAFE SPARE MATERIAL
Mark it ABSENT. Keep essential clothing, shelter, insulation and first-aid material.
DO NOT MOVE ONLY TO BE SEEN
No clearing, ridge, road, water, cliff, climbing or tree cutting just to signal.
NO COLOUR, SIZE, SHAPE OR RANGE IS APPROVED · READ PANEL C · DO NOT USE DETACHED
SOUND + SUNLIGHT + NIGHT MODES
WORKING CARD · PANEL C OF 3 · PANELS A–B CONTROL
CONDITIONAL PARALLEL MODES — NOT A SEQUENCE
Whole card: 90% source-match; 60% completeness/layout — not outcome odds.
Use with Panels A–B. Keep urgent care, shelter, warmth and contact going.
SOUND
With a whistle: use IM-185 — three distinct short blasts; stop and listen.
Without one: answer a nearby voice with short calls, then listen.
Do not exhaust a casualty or blow near an ear. No seconds, range or reply code.
PURPOSE-MADE MIRROR IN SUNLIGHT
Use a purpose-made sighting mirror only after practice; follow its exact instructions.
Without one, mark it ABSENT. No tested foil or ordinary-mirror method is supplied.
Do not assume equal results. Never look at the sun or use a laser. No range promised.
CONTROLLED NIGHT LIGHT
With a tested light: use Chapter 9. Preserve contact and care power.
Without one: mark it ABSENT. This card supplies no fire, flare or pyrotechnic method.
A generic strobe or “SOS mode” does not prove aviation or night-vision visibility.
POSSIBLE REPLY ≠ CONFIRMED CONTACT
Continue the plan until a responsible responder gives direct instructions.
NOT FIELD-APPROVED · USE ALL 3 PANELS · LIFE-FIRST RULE CREATES NO MISSING METHOD
